chapter: Buddy Rich, Alvino Rey and Manhattan School
title: Georgie Auld's band in 1946
summary: Mandel found Georgie Auld's swinging band fun, with charts by Al Cohn, Manny Albam and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. So before we get into that too much we skipped Georgie Auld and Alvino Rey.

Yeah well… well Georgie Auld was a fun band to play in, it was kind of, again a real swinging band. Georgie had a very good book, he was fun to work with, he was a great player himself, we had a lot of good charts, Al Cohn, Manny Albam, Bud Johnson, all kinds of people. Fun stuff to play, Georgie was a good guy and then I went with Alvino.

That period in ‘46 between that first Buddy Rich band and Alvino. And we were doing mostly one nighters, working out of New York going all over the place at that time. And I went with Alvino and stayed there for the rest of the year.
